latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Instantly turn portraits or product photos into animated 1080p video clips using LoRA models.

- Accepts image uploads or just a description to generate video via cloud GPUs, no local setup required.
- Simple commands support exporting, checking credits, session state, or adding edits with prompts.
- Automatically manages backend authentication, sessions, and export for a seamless workflow.
- Supports multiple file formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Error-handling for credits, tokens, and file issues built in; tips provided for best results.
